purpose: Descriptive SCC comparison of one frozen runtime: options, designs and controls at one million rows and four cores; core scaling; size series on one node each; FixedEffectModels.jl for linear models

policy.purpose: Descriptive SCC comparison of one frozen runtime: options, designs and controls at one million rows and four cores; core scaling; size series on one node each; FixedEffectModels.jl for linear models

stopped_tasks.reason: Started on a Xeon Gold 6132 (Skylake) node; the campaign uses E5-2680v4 nodes. Stopped with qdel after 25 fit positions, before its timings were inspected, and resubmitted as job 8302543 with -l cpu_type=E5-2680v4.

production_comparison_ratio_convention: Per-fit ratio is fereg/comparator; summary CSV speedup is the median paired comparator/fereg ratio over agreeing repetitions.
capture_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({capture, objective}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False). Objective is parsed as binary64.
limitations: Descriptive Linux comparison on one fixed seed; three to five repetitions per configuration.
Each design and model ran on one node; absolute times across designs and nodes also reflect node speed, recorded by the per-node reference cell.
Agreement by convention removes one covariance scalar from absorbed degrees-of-freedom counting; strict eligibility and tolerances are unchanged.
A command that reached the time limit was not attempted at larger sizes of its series.
